Hi Samantha / Novum ops team,

We're finalizing flight bookings for the Redwood Executive Offsite (June 14-16). Attached is the latest attendee roster (rvw_itinerary_v3.pdf) — please use it to lock fares and seats. Key asks: 

- Can you confirm OTA fares and PNRs for the 10-person exec group by EOD Tue (6/1)?

- We need any special meal requests captured (vegetarian: 2, gluten-free: 1).
- For any flight > 3.5 hours, propose bulkhead or extra-legroom seats if available (we'll sign for added upsell).
- Include ground transfer ETA window to Hotel Indigo on arrival — we'll coordinate shuttle times once flights are locked.

I'm copying Jonas and Lauren for internal confirmations. Please also attach boarding_roster.csv and a stub PNR file when available.

Thanks — Vivek

Hi Vivek — thanks for the roster. Quick update/questions below.

1) Preliminary fares held for 24 hours: attached are two routing options per traveler (routes_A_B.pdf stub). I've also attached a preliminary boarding_roster.csv with seat block suggestions.
2) For Jonas and Soojin I can request aisle confirmation; bulkhead/ex-legroom availability requires immediate approval. If you want to accept the upgrade quotes, confirm which card we should charge or whether Redwood will cover via corporate account.
3) One itinerary (for the CEO) routes SFO->JFK->PDX with a tighter connection (45 mins). We can re-route to a single nonstop SFO->PDX to eliminate risk but fare delta is ~$220. Do you want me to hold the nonstop?
4) Hotel Indigo has a small change to the room block — they can guarantee late check-in for 4 rooms at no extra cost if we provide an arrival manifest 72 hours prior (I can send the hotel_block_details.pdf).

Next steps I suggest: you confirm seat-upgrade policy and whether to accept the CEO nonstop delta. I can then issue PNRs and send a secure waiver link for the group to accept travel T&Cs.

Best,
